title: Restriction of an arbitrary stage model morphism
statement: Let $X,Y,Z$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an open cover of $X$, and $q:Y\to X$, $p:Z\to Y$, $t:Z\to X$ with $p\mathbin{\gg}q=t$ [def-pc-base-change]. Write $V=U\times_XY$, $W=V\times_YZ$, $U^t=U\times_XZ$, with chart projections $v_d:V_d\to U_d$, $w_d:W_d\to V_d$, $u_d:U^t_d\to U_d$. Let $d_d:W_d\to U^t_d$ be the universal lift with projections $W_d\to Z$ and $w_d\mathbin{\gg}v_d$, as in [def-pc-overlap-pair-canonical-comparisons]. Fix $a,b\in U.I_0$ and module sheaves $N_d$ on $U_d$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Put $K= W_a\times_ZW_b$ with projections $r_a,r_b$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. All products and comparisons are the canonical chosen pullbacks. Write $P_f$ for tensor pullback and $f^*$ for abstract module pullback. Let $C_d:w_d^*v_d^*N_d\simeq d_d^*u_d^*N_d$ be pullback composition along $w_d,v_d$, followed by congruence along $d_d\mathbin{\gg}u_d=w_d\mathbin{\gg}v_d$, followed by inverse composition along $d_d,u_d$. Given a scheme $H$, maps $h_d:H\to U^t_d$ for $d=a,b$, $z:K\to H$ with $z\mathbin{\gg}h_d=r_d\mathbin{\gg}d_d$, module sheaves $S_d$ on $H$, and isomorphisms $\tau_d:S_d\simeq h_d^*u_d^*N_d$, define $\xi_d:z^*S_d\simeq r_d^*w_d^*v_d^*N_d$ by pullback of $\tau_d$, composition and congruence along $z\mathbin{\gg}h_d=r_d\mathbin{\gg}d_d$, inverse composition along $r_d,d_d$, and pullback of $C_d^{-1}$. Composition in all displayed formulas is Lean order, written $\mathbin{\gg}$ [def-pc-local-overlap-transitions]. The canonical comparisons may be supplied as named isomorphisms together with equations identifying them with the prescribed composites. Now take schemes $H_0,H_k,H$ and maps $q_0:H_k\to H_0$, $p_0:H\to H_k$, $t_0:H\to H_0$ with $p_0\mathbin{\gg}q_0=t_0$, maps $r_{0d}:H_0\to U_d$, $d:V_a\times_YV_b\to H_k$, and $k_d:H\to U_d$, for $d=a,b$. Require $(d\mathbin{\gg}q_0)\mathbin{\gg}r_{0d}=s_d\mathbin{\gg}v_d$ where $s_a,s_b$ are the stage overlap projections, $t_0\mathbin{\gg}r_{0d}=k_d=h_d\mathbin{\gg}u_d$, and $z\mathbin{\gg}p_0=l\mathbin{\gg}d$ where $l:K\to V_a\times_YV_b$ is the universal lift of $r_a\mathbin{\gg}w_a,r_b\mathbin{\gg}w_b$. Put $F_d=r_{0d}^*N_d$, $S_d=P_{t_0}F_d$, and let $\eta_f:P_f\simeq f^*$ be the unique adjunction comparison [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. In the definition of $\xi_d$ take $\tau_d$ to be $\eta_{t_0}(F_d)$ followed by composition/congruence from $t_0^*r_{0d}^*N_d$ to $k_d^*N_d$, followed by inverse composition/congruence to $h_d^*u_d^*N_d$. Let $s'_d:d^*P_{q_0}F_d\simeq s_d^*v_d^*N_d$ be pullback of $\eta_{q_0}$, composition along $d,q_0$, composition/congruence along $(d\mathbin{\gg}q_0)\mathbin{\gg}r_{0d}=s_d\mathbin{\gg}v_d$, and inverse composition along $s_d,v_d$. Let $\sigma:P_{t_0}\simeq P_{q_0}P_{p_0}$ be the tensor composition comparison [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso]. For any alpha:P_q0 F_a -> P_q0 F_b, any theta:P_t0 F_a -> P_t0 F_b satisfying sigma_Fa.hom followed by P_p0(alpha) equals theta followed by sigma_Fb.hom, and any pair morphism phi equal to s'_a.inv followed by d^*alpha followed by s'_b.hom, the canonical overlap base change BC(phi) equals xi_a.inv followed by z^*theta followed by xi_b.hom. The four supplied comparison isomorphisms are required to equal the explicit canonical composites above. This statement concerns an arbitrary theta, not a prescribed descent transition: no limit module M or component isomorphisms e are arguments. All compositions are in Lean order.

proof.text: Substitute the four canonicality equations. Let l be the universal overlap lift and E the tensor/abstract square comparison. Apply overlap_base_change_formula to express pair base change as Ba inverse followed by l*φ followed by Bb hom, and substitute the given expression for φ.

Apply overlap_model_chart_factorization separately to charts a and b. Use the correct lift projection on each chart, and use the second projection of overlapIteratedChartHom to identify δ followed by the direct chart projection. This factors ξa and ξb through z*σ, E, l* of their respective stage comparisons and Ba or Bb.

Precompose the supplied tensor compatibility equation by σ_F inverse to solve for P_p₀(α), and apply z*. Expand the two factorizations by functoriality. Naturality_1 of E identifies E inverse followed by z*P_p₀(α) followed by E hom with l*d*(α). Associativity identifies the source and target exterior factors, giving the desired equality.

theorem overlap_stage_model_restriction
    {X Y Z H₀ Hₖ Hlim : Scheme.{u}} (U : X.OpenCover.{u})
    (q : Y ⟶ X) (p : Z ⟶ Y) (t : Z ⟶ X) (h : p ≫ q = t)
    (N : (d : U.I₀) → (U.X d).Modules) (a b : U.I₀)
    (q₀ : Hₖ ⟶ H₀) (p₀ : Hlim ⟶ Hₖ) (t₀ : Hlim ⟶ H₀) (h₀ : p₀ ≫ q₀ = t₀)
    (r₀a : H₀ ⟶ U.X a) (r₀b : H₀ ⟶ U.X b)
    (d : pullback ((U.pullback₁ q).f a) ((U.pullback₁ q).f b) ⟶ Hₖ)
    (ha : Hlim ⟶ (U.pullback₁ t).X a) (hb : Hlim ⟶ (U.pullback₁ t).X b)
    (hka : (d ≫ q₀) ≫ r₀a = pullback.fst _ _ ≫ U.pullbackHom q a)
    (hkb : (d ≫ q₀) ≫ r₀b = pullback.snd _ _ ≫ U.pullbackHom q b)
    (ka : Hlim ⟶ U.X a) (kb : Hlim ⟶ U.X b)
    (hla : t₀ ≫ r₀a = ka) (hlb : t₀ ≫ r₀b = kb)
    (hda : ha ≫ U.pullbackHom t a = ka)
    (hdb : hb ≫ U.pullbackHom t b = kb)
    (z : pullback (((U.pullback₁ q).pullback₁ p).f a)
      (((U.pullback₁ q).pullback₁ p).f b) ⟶ Hlim)
    (hza : z ≫ ha = pullback.fst _ _ ≫ overlapIteratedChartHom U q p t h a)
    (hzb : z ≫ hb = pullback.snd _ _ ≫ overlapIteratedChartHom U q p t h b)
    (hz : z ≫ p₀ =
      pullback.lift
        (pullback.fst _ _ ≫ Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom (U.pullback₁ q) p a)
        (pullback.snd _ _ ≫ Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom (U.pullback₁ q) p b) (by
          rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom_map,
            Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom_map, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc,
            pullback.condition]) ≫ d) :
    let F := (Scheme.Modules.pullback r₀a).obj (N a)
    let G := (Scheme.Modules.pullback r₀b).obj (N b)
    let σ := Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackCompositionIso p₀ q₀ t₀ h₀
    let canonicalτa := overlapDirectModelComparison t₀ r₀a ka ha
      (U.pullbackHom t a) hla hda (N a)
    let canonicalτb := overlapDirectModelComparison t₀ r₀b kb hb
      (U.pullbackHom t b) hlb hdb (N b)
    let canonicalsa := overlapStageModelComparison d q₀ r₀a
      (pullback.fst _ _) (U.pullbackHom q a) hka (N a)
    let canonicalsb := overlapStageModelComparison d q₀ r₀b
      (pullback.snd _ _) (U.pullbackHom q b) hkb (N b)
    ∀ (τa : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback t₀).obj F ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback ha).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom t a)).obj (N a)))
      (τb : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback t₀).obj G ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback hb).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom t b)).obj (N b)))
      (sa : (Scheme.Modules.pullback d).obj ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q₀).obj F) ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback
          (pullback.fst ((U.pullback₁ q).f a) ((U.pullback₁ q).f b))).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q a)).obj (N a)))
      (sb : (Scheme.Modules.pullback d).obj ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q₀).obj G) ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback
          (pullback.snd ((U.pullback₁ q).f a) ((U.pullback₁ q).f b))).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q b)).obj (N b))),
      τa = canonicalτa → τb = canonicalτb → sa = canonicalsa → sb = canonicalsb →
    let ξa := overlapDirectRestrictionIso U q p t h N a b a ha z
      (pullback.fst _ _) hza ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback t₀).obj F) τa
    let ξb := overlapDirectRestrictionIso U q p t h N a b b hb z
      (pullback.snd _ _) hzb ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback t₀).obj G) τb
    ∀ α : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q₀).obj F ⟶
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q₀).obj G,
    ∀ θ : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback t₀).obj F ⟶
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback t₀).obj G,
      σ.hom.app F ≫ (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p₀).map α = θ ≫ σ.hom.app G →
    ∀ φ : (Scheme.Modules.pullback
        (pullback.fst ((U.pullback₁ q).f a) ((U.pullback₁ q).f b))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q a)).obj (N a)) ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback
        (pullback.snd ((U.pullback₁ q).f a) ((U.pullback₁ q).f b))).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q b)).obj (N b)),
      φ = sa.inv ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback d).map α ≫ sb.hom →
      modulesPseudofunctor.overlapPairBaseChangeHom
        ((U.pullback₁ q).f a) ((U.pullback₁ q).f b) p
        (Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom (U.pullback₁ q) p a)
        (Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom (U.pullback₁ q) p b)
        (((U.pullback₁ q).pullback₁ p).f a) (((U.pullback₁ q).pullback₁ p).f b)
        (Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom_map (U.pullback₁ q) p a)
        (Scheme.Cover.pullbackHom_map (U.pullback₁ q) p b)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q a)).obj (N a))
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q b)).obj (N b))
        φ = ξa.inv ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback z).map θ ≫ ξb.hom
